feature: Port Workflow Orchestrator Script (Green Zone Only)
description: Implement an interactive 'Smart Form' script to interview users and generate high-quality, standardized `spec.md` files, adapting logic from the `PRPs-agentic-eng` workflow orchestrator.

subtasks.description: Analyze `prp_workflow.py` to shortlist reusable logic for interviewing and context gathering. Identify dependencies.
subtasks.verification: Create a design document or notes summarizing the logic to be ported.

subtasks.description: Define the input/output contract for `spec_generator.py`. It should accept an output directory and optional initial prompt.
Implement the core interactive class `SpecGenerator` in `apps/tools/spec_generator.py`. Include methods for asking questions (Goal, Why, What).
subtasks.verification: Run script and verify it prompts the user.

subtasks.description: Implement `ContextGatherer` logic. Use `fd` or file walking to suggest relevant files based on user keywords.
subtasks.verification: Script suggests valid file paths for a given topic.

subtasks.description: Implement Markdown generation. Ensure the output strictly follows the `PRPs-Framework` spec template.
subtasks.verification: Generated file is a valid markdown with required headers.

subtasks.description: Modify `.cursor/commands/07-Spec.md` to run `python apps/tools/spec_generator.py` instead of creating an empty file.
subtasks.verification: Command `/07-Spec` launches the new interactive flow.

subtasks.description: End-to-End Test: Run `/07-Spec` to create a dummy task spec.
subtasks.verification: A new valid spec file is created in the correct directory.
